description: Source code for CometAPI Embedding API support, providing classes and methods for configuring, validating, transforming requests/responses, and handling errors for the CometAPI embedding service, which is compatible with OpenAI's API.

classes.name: CometAPIEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for CometAPI Embedding API, supporting URL construction, environment validation, parameter mapping, request/response transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the CometAPI embedding endpoint.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares authentication headers and validates environment setup for API requests.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by CometAPI.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to CometAPI-specific format.

methods.name: transform_embedding_request
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format expected by CometAPI for embedding requests.

methods.name: transform_embedding_response
methods.description: Converts raw API response into standard EmbeddingResponse format, handling JSON parsing and errors.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns the appropriate exception class for API errors.
